record.title: Recover the stock userspace initialization contract statically
record.intent: Replace per-access discovery with whole-subsystem operation grammar and explicit ambiguity boundaries.
requirements: Pin the unchanged stock native library and recover the observed startup hardware-call chain and surrounding subsystem routines.
Inventory direct callers of register reads/writes and hardware-facing open, mmap, ioctl and DMA functions; retain unresolved indirect edges explicitly.
Recover complete ADC initialization routines, tables, loops, modes, masks, delays, error propagation and later writable-state operations rather than just the observed prefix.
Identify neighboring initialization dependencies and reads whose values control branches, polling, returned state or upstream consumers.
Express a typed TOML operation graph with provenance, conditions, order/loop structure and classifications STATIC-DETERMINED, RUNTIME-SELECTED, HARDWARE-RETURNED, ASYNCHRONOUS or UNKNOWN.
Use Kotlin for reusable authored analysis tooling; preserve raw external disassembly and do not change stock artifacts or run a guest.
acceptance: Independently check instruction/table/call-site evidence and reconcile the graph with existing dynamic witnesses without treating unobserved predictions as runtime facts.
Publish explicit coverage and unresolved-edge limits; do not claim an entire library or hardware contract recovered merely because known routines are decoded.
